name: com.awdk.agenttools
description: Editor-only, read-only checks for coding agents building VRChat worlds: geometric and render-based z-fighting detection, camera captures, play-mode performance sampling and a world audit. Every entry point is a static method that returns plain text, designed to be called from a Unity MCP execute_code tool. Long work is time-sliced on EditorApplication.update and polled with Status().
